description: Synthetic 24 h of readings, one every 30 minutes for all 18 seeded sensors. minutes_ago is relative to the moment the file is loaded. Scenarios: machine 3 temperature climbing towards its 85 C limit; machine 4 vibration crossing its 7.1 mm/s limit; machine 2 pressure falling towards its 2 bar minimum; machine 5 temperature sitting in the WARN zone; everything else stable.
